text:
I fixed all the bugs I found in `catalog/`, but I haven't run `python3 -m unittest`. I have no shell tool in this session, so the suite is unverified. Please run it to confirm.

The fixes, found by reading each module against its test:
- **`books.py`:** `parse_book` now converts the year to an `int`.
- **`factory.py`:** `sample_books` now includes `Emma`, so it returns the three titles the tests expect.
- **`fees.py`:** `late_fee` now multiplies days by the daily rate. It was adding them.
- **`inventory.py`:** `recent(n)` now returns exactly the last `n` events. It was returning `n + 1`.
- **`members.py`:** `MAX_BORROWED` is now 5, matching the lending-policy comment and the tests.
- **`search.py`:** it now imports `normalize` from `catalog.text`. The old `catalog.nonexistent` module doesn't exist.

I didn't touch any of the tests.
